scope: Complete selected feature families and numerical recipes. This is not the emitted frozen_feature_record, an access seal, or evidence of feature extraction.

runtime_recipe.low_level_modules: Discovered existing devel/math/viz modules: py-scikit-image/0.24.0_py312 depends on py-scipy/1.12.0_py312 and py-numpy/1.26.3_py312. Load plain py-pillow/10.2.0_py312 last to select that implementation ahead of scikit-image's Pillow-SIMD dependency; record actual imported versions/paths in compute.
runtime_recipe.status: Selected versions, not an assertion that this complete environment exists or has been tested. Module/group-environment discovery precedes any installation.
runtime_recipe.inference: eval plus inference_mode; float32 model arithmetic and stored embeddings; no autocast, TF32, augmentation, dropout, fine-tuning or EEG-based feature selection
runtime_recipe.image_decode: Pillow decoded raster converted to RGB; preserve pixel orientation as stored, no EXIF transpose or ICC color conversion; remove source metadata before delivery to image worker
runtime_recipe.determinism: Use deterministic supported operations; a missing deterministic implementation is a technical issue to resolve before extraction, not permission to alter features after scores.
runtime_recipe.batch_size: Outcome-blind resource-pilot choice only; record actual value and numerical consistency. It does not select a model or feature family.

worker_boundaries.trusted_builder: Uses the frozen event/archive join to supply decoded RGB pixels and opaque nonsemantic IDs. Owns the ID-to-source crosswalk outside image workers.
worker_boundaries.caption_worker: Same image-only interface. It sees no concept prompt, folder or provider name. Generated text is a pixel-derived output.
worker_boundaries.label_worker: Separate source-metadata process joins uniqueID to provider Word/WordContext and human columns; it does not supply text to image or caption workers.
worker_boundaries.deployment: Implement the declared input/read boundary before extraction; changing names only in final output is insufficient. The failed EEG-runtime sentinel is not a verified boundary for any actual worker.

low_level_851.implementation: Episode-local deterministic descriptor in code/feature_extractors.py; selected formula implemented, actual source-image feature extraction remains pending
low_level_851.training_lineage: No fitted or pretrained image model
low_level_851.license: Episode-authored numerical composition using NumPy/SciPy and scikit-image; scikit-image BSD-3-Clause source license. Image research terms remain separate.
low_level_851.preprocessing: RGB whole raster resized to 256x256 with Pillow bilinear; channel values divided by 255. No crop. Original width/height retained for aspect ratio. Gray = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B on these encoded values, without sRGB linearization.

components_in_order.name: spatial_RGB_moments
components_in_order.rule: Split 256x256 into 4x4 nonoverlapping 64x64 cells, row-major. For each cell and R,G,B, append mean then population SD (ddof=0).

components_in_order.name: RGB_histogram
components_in_order.rule: R,G,B order; 16 equal bins over [0,1], left-inclusive/right-exclusive except final endpoint included; divide counts by 65536.

components_in_order.name: oriented_frequency_power
components_in_order.rule: Subtract gray image mean, fft2(norm='forward'); frequencies from fftfreq(256). Radial edges [0,1/128,1/64,1/32,1/16,1/8,1/4,1/2,sqrt(1/2)], angle atan2(fy,fx) modulo pi with 8 equal bins. Radial-major then angular order; mean log1p(abs(F)^2) in each bin, include last radial upper edge. DC is excluded; a geometrically empty bin is exactly zero.

components_in_order.name: Gabor_texture
components_in_order.rule: Frequencies [1/32,1/16,1/8,1/4] cycles/pixel; theta=k*pi/8 for k=0..7. On integer grid -ceil(3*sigma)..ceil(3*sigma), sigma=0.56/f, K=exp(-(x*x+y*y)/(2*sigma*sigma))*exp(2*pi*i*f*(x*cos(theta)+y*sin(theta))); subtract K's complex mean then divide by sqrt(sum(abs(K)^2)). Convolve gray image with K with scipy.ndimage reflect boundary. Append spatial mean then population SD of complex-response magnitude, frequency-major/theta order.

components_in_order.name: HOG_geometry
components_in_order.rule: skimage.feature.hog(gray, orientations=9, pixels_per_cell=(32,32), cells_per_block=(1,1), block_norm='L2-Hys', visualize=False, transform_sqrt=False, feature_vector=True, channel_axis=None).

components_in_order.name: global_geometry_and_contrast
components_in_order.rule: Original width/height ratio, gray mean, gray population SD; that order.

supervised_resnet50_v1.license: Torchvision v0.19.1 code is BSD-3-Clause. Its official pretrained-model notice says weight terms may derive from training datasets; no separate weight-specific grant is asserted here. Retain and resolve the applicable source terms before candidate-discriminating scores.
supervised_resnet50_v1.preprocessing: RGB PIL shortest-edge resize 256 bilinear, center crop224, divide by255, normalize mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] and SD [0.229,0.224,0.225]; pinned V1 preset
supervised_resnet50_v1.selected_layer: Final avgpool flattened, before fc; no classifier logits

dino_resnet50.model: Official DINO ResNet-50 backbone loaded into torchvision v0.19.1 ResNet-50 with fc=Identity
dino_resnet50.training_lineage: DINO self-distillation on ImageNet-1K, independently trained from the supervised ResNet checkpoint
dino_resnet50.license: Official DINO source repository Apache-2.0; record the official checkpoint release and applicable training-data notices with the acquired asset rather than relabel ImageNet or THINGS as Apache-2.0.
dino_resnet50.preprocessing: RGB PIL shortest-edge resize256 bicubic, center crop224, divide by255; ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], SD [0.229,0.224,0.225], following DINO linear-evaluation transform
dino_resnet50.selected_layer: Final avgpool flattened; projection head and classifier absent

clip_vit_b32_image.training_lineage: OpenAI CLIP contrastive image-text training on publicly available web image/text; exact overlap with THINGS images is unknown
clip_vit_b32_image.license: Official OpenAI CLIP repository MIT. The inspected HF card has no separate weight-specific license field; retain this distinction and source research-use model card, do not assert an independently verified checkpoint-license statement.
clip_vit_b32_image.selected_layer: Projected pooled image embedding; L2-normalize each vector (explicit recipe choice)

blip_caption_clip_text.training_lineage: Salesforce BLIP multimodal pretraining and COCO image-captioning base release with ViT-base; exact THINGS pretraining overlap unknown
blip_caption_clip_text.license: Official checkpoint card BSD-3-Clause; subsequent CLIP text embedding uses the separately documented CLIP source terms
blip_caption_clip_text.preprocessing: RGB square bicubic resize384x384, no center crop, rescale1/255; CLIP mean and SD as in clip_vit_b32_image
blip_caption_clip_text.generation_rule: No user/label prompt; use pinned model decoder start/EOS/PAD tokens. Decode with skip_special_tokens=True and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False; strip surrounding whitespace only. Report length-cap and empty-caption counts; do not exclude or manually rewrite images/captions. Empty generated text is embedded as empty text.
blip_caption_clip_text.selected_layer: Generated caption passed to text_encoder below, projected EOS embedding L2-normalized

dinov2_vit_b14.training_lineage: DINOv2 ViT-B distilled from independently pretrained ViT-g on LVD-142M; distinct trained encoder/data lineage from core DINO ResNet-50. Do not describe ViT-B as independently trained from its own DINOv2 teacher.
dinov2_vit_b14.license: Apache-2.0, explicit official DINOv2 model card
dinov2_vit_b14.preprocessing: RGB shortest-edge resize256 bicubic, center crop224, rescale1/255, ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], SD [0.229,0.224,0.225] from pinned processor
dinov2_vit_b14.selected_layer: Concatenate final LayerNorm CLS token768 and mean of all 256 final LayerNorm patch tokens768; no register tokens, no classifier, no earlier layers

concept_name_clip_text.name_rule: Use nonblank provider_WordContext verbatim after surrounding whitespace strip; otherwise provider_Word with an explicit per-concept fallback flag. If both blank, stop source qualification without dropping or inventing a concept name.
concept_name_clip_text.selected_layer: text_encoder projected EOS embedding, L2-normalized; numeric/opaque concept identifiers never enter text
concept_name_clip_text.lineage_and_license: Same pinned CLIP text model as generated captions; this shared latent representation is disclosed and is not an independent semantic measurement

human_properties_12.lineage: Pinned THINGS human aggregate means, corrected current arousal and perceived-size rating; preserve source units, no deprecated arousing, trial counts, RTs or worker responses
human_properties_12.missing_rule: Observed zero missing values in all1854 concepts. No imputation. A later missing/nonfinite value is a source-integrity error; no silent zero-fill or concept removal.

human_categories_53.column_order: All category53:: columns in the durable crosswalk table's existing source order
human_categories_53.lineage: Pinned provider category53_wide-format.tsv, all membership indicators, multi-hot; no27-category taxonomy and no concept-identity one-hot
human_categories_53.missing_rule: Observed zero missing numeric values. Retain all406 all-zero membership rows; lack of a listed broad category is not missing data. No imputation, reassignment or dropping.
human_categories_53.influence_scope: Leave-one-broad-category diagnostics use the same53 provider memberships and disclose nonexhaustive and overlapping coverage. Concepts with no membership remain in the full analysis.

text_encoder.tokenizer: Pinned tokenizer files; model max_length77 including special tokens; truncation=True, truncation_side='right', padding='max_length', preserve terminal EOS. Report every truncated ID without exclusion.
text_encoder.selected_layer: Projected pooled EOS text feature512; per-vector L2 normalization
text_encoder.nonfinite_or_zero_norm: Technical failure; no silent replacement, exclusion or text regeneration

training_only_transforms.fit_unit: Image-family transforms fit once per unique image in the current participant's permitted training blocks; label-family transforms fit once per unique concept represented in those same training blocks. Inner folds fit anew on their eight training blocks; outer refits use ten. Held-out values never fit transforms.
training_only_transforms.scaling: Per-family column mean and population SD (ddof=0) on training rows. Exactly zero-SD columns map to zero and are recorded; no held-out variance estimate.
training_only_transforms.PCA: Centered scaled training matrix, deterministic full SVD in float64; no whitening. Orient each loading so its largest-magnitude entry (lowest-index tie) is positive. Apply training mean/SD/loadings unchanged to validation/held-out rows.
training_only_transforms.effective_rank: min(requested_rank, number_of_features, number_of_training_rows-1, numerical_training_rank); numerical rank counts singular values greater than max(matrix.shape)*float64_epsilon*largest_singular_value. Record requested and effective ranks. This algebraic cap retains all available human dimensions and all grid branches; no invented zero-padding or family removal.
training_only_transforms.post_PCA: No whitening or extra family variance rescaling. Retain all registered core families, each reduced separately. Expanded panel appends its extra family.
training_only_transforms.label_model: Both linear-label and its capacity-matched RBF slot use the same transformed continuous name/property/category vectors; no uniqueID or concept-number column enters either. Kernel bandwidth multipliers, df matching and penalty grids remain exactly the existing policy.
training_only_transforms.RBF_reference_bandwidth: Median of strictly positive pairwise Euclidean distances among distinct training-concept rows of the concatenated transformed label families; compute separately inside each training fold and rank setting. For policy multiplier m, K(x,y)=exp(-||x-y||^2/(2*(m*median_distance)^2)). A missing positive distance is a model-identifiability failure, not permission to insert an arbitrary scale.
training_only_transforms.remaining_model_implementation: Continuous-time fitting, penalty/df matching and numerical rank/conditioning qualification still require their model implementation. This feature recipe does not claim that implementation exists.

visual_only_distance.rationale: Fix one low-level, supervised and self-supervised family for the explanatory distance. The expanded encoder enriches the terminal image model without changing this prespecified explanatory stratifier.
visual_only_distance.normalization: Use raw selected feature dimensions, training-only column centering/population-SD scaling, then L2 normalization of each vector. No rank search or PCA in this distance panel; zero-SD columns map to zero as above. A zero-norm vector is an explicit technical problem, not an automatic near/distant assignment.
visual_only_distance.distance: Per family, minimum cosine distance from each held-out image to its ten same-concept training exemplars. Average the three distances with equal family weights.
visual_only_distance.strata: For each participant/outer fold, sort all3708 held-out main images by distance ascending then opaque_image_id for exact ties; first1236 near, next1236 middle, final1236 distant. Report boundary tie counts. No held-out EEG is used and image IDs only resolve equal-distance ties.
visual_only_distance.false_partition_matching: This explanatory three-family panel does not narrow the policy's all-registered-image-family, every-fold false-partition acceptance requirements.
